'''Find Gate''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -1

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Movement''': Cast and exhaust to immediately return to Arkham from an [[Other World]].
